posts.meta_description:
2M likes, 4,468 comments - rashmika_mandanna on October 18, 2026: "Guyssss, I just want to share a little experience with you all ❤️🥹

All these years, I’ve heard so many stories about where Vijay grew up, where he studied, his school days.. cz all his friends are from school and they studied in Puttaparthi.. so I’ve always been calling them parthi boys and girl and along the way, they’ve become my best friends too ❤️

And I always felt like it was a missing puzzle cz that was one place that I hadn’t seen or been to.. but I’d heard so much about.. ❤️

Finally, I got the beautiful opportunity to visit Puttaparthi, see the school where they studied, their classrooms, their dorms and meet so many lovely people there and meet HM aunty ❤️ and she’s the SWEETEST person ever.. ❤️❤️ 
I really cannot explain how peaceful I felt being there.. there was something about that place that made my heart feel so calm.. everything felt so soo beautiful and divine 🙏🏻❤️

I’ve always wondered how Vijay, Anand and all the Puttaparthi boys and girls share so many similar values.. and rest of the family as well.. ❤️❤️ The way they are, the way they treat people, the way they believe in love and kindness and when I visited their school, I think I finally understood where so much of it comes from.. ❤️❤️❤️

As children, the places we grow up in, the people we spend time with, and the lessons our parents and teachers teach us become such a big part of who we are. And watching those little children sing vedas and bhajans with so much devotion, knowing their shlokas and chanting with all their heart just moved me so much ❤️

The teaching of ‘Love All, Serve All’ has always felt so close to my heart.. its how I have always been.. and this little experience left me feeling so much love, gratitude and peace ❤️❤️

And there’s one little thought I keep coming back to… maybe Swami wanted me to visit Puttaparthi at this point in my life.. cz the time felt right❤️❤️

Some places teach you things without you even realising it and sometimes you understand a little more about the people you love by understanding where they come from..❤️".

posts.meta_description:
2M likes, 5,926 comments - rashmika_mandanna on October 17, 2026: "Jayamma !! ❤️

A woman whose love is so pure!! 
She spoke to me about what being a woman is truly about. Standing up for her people, protecting her people loving her people with all she has. ❤️❤️

There is so much love pouring in for Ranabaali and Jayamma, and I feel so overwhelmed and happy. ❤️

The film speaks about the strength we have as a community, our belief in God, our strength to celebrate the little things even in the darkest of times, and how we all stand as one when someone from outside tries to intervene.. we don’t just stand and watch - we fight, and that’s what Ranabaali is about! We all fighting together for the same cause! ❤️

Watching Ranabaali is an experience that shouldn’t be missed in the theatres.. I don’t say this cz it’s my film.. but I say this because when there is a good film that’s made.. it’s important that it should be experienced fully! ❤️

@rahulsankrityan is one of the most BEAUTIFUL storytellers we have in our country today and I really hope his storytelling is always and always protected.. and I truly am glad he’s seeing all of his hard work being appreciated by you loveliest people.. ❤️❤️

@thedeverakonda - I told you and I keep telling you that I am a fan and I will forever be a fan of your work.. today seeing everyone appreciate you and your hard work (which you always do) and your work brings me one great sense of joy and peace and happiness.. my heart is happy happy for you! 🥰🥰🥰🥰❤️

The whole team has come together so beautifully to complete this film together!! ❤️
Thankyou to each and every one of you who’s made this film what it is today! ❤️ 
And to everyone who’s already watched the film - biggesttt bone-crushing hugs to you! ❤️
THANK YOU!!! 
Seeing you all love the film and love Jayamma means more to me than I can explain in words!!🥹❤️

I hope Ranabaali stays with you long after you leave the theatres! ❤️

With all my love, 
Your Jayamma! ❤️".

posts.meta_description:
519K likes, 4,039 comments - rashmika_mandanna on October 13, 2026: "There is something in the characters you play that influence you.. A lot of you keep asking are there any similarities between Jayamma and me and my answer is yes - and this is one of them.. this has always been me and this is also her.. and I would always keep doing things like this for all the love that you give me.. but always kept it under the wraps cz I thought if I knew and just my team knew and just a bunch of us knew.. it was enough.. but now I am opening up about this because I am thinking.. if this could influence you lovelies out there to do anything like this.. I would be happy. ❤️

So hence I thought why not start now.. with this! ❤️❤️ 

I’ve adopted 400 families today.. and I want to just help 400 families at a time for 3 months each and continue this for the next one year and hope that they can save that money of groceries and use it to save and plan their futures better.. ❤️❤️

Even a small act of kindness can change a person’s life and it doesn’t have to be big.. let’s all start with something small! ❤️

And trust me all these smiles are worth every sleepless nights, the injuries, the struggles, the pain the tears the everything that I’ve gone had to go through over the last working years.. this is priceless!!❤️".
